verdict.rationale: Orrick offers self-service document generators (Tech Studio) and client portals with file sharing (Orrick Connect), so data portability is a fair question for these products. The evidence pack never documents bulk export of user data in open formats or any exit or offboarding path. Tech Studio's 'open source' framing refers to free access to forms, not data portability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
